exposure: Use of fat emulsions in TPN
outcome: Prevalence of Candida species in BSI
Antifungal susceptibility profile of Candida isolates
cohort: 1350 neonates clinically suspected to have blood stream infection
finding: C. tropicalis was the predominant Candida species isolated from neonates with BSI, and low birth weight, broad-spectrum antibiotic use, respiratory distress, and preterm delivery were the major associated risk factors.
birth_weight: Low birth weight mentioned as a risk factor
